findings.suggestion: Add a small unit test for cookie read/commit round-tripping; it would have caught this before the acceptance run.

summary: A disciplined, fast session: full reconnaissance of spec, tests and existing architecture before coding, a well-reasoned cookie-backed SSR design that anticipated the no-flash requirement, and a single root-cause fix cycle when team tests failed. Verification was layered (targeted, full acceptance, app unit suite, git hygiene) but entirely test-driven with no browser-level check of the new page. The only blemishes are a few self-inflicted code slips and small tool-call wastes, each recovered within a turn.
